_about: One row per weapon or ammo item. param_row = new EquipParamWeapon row cloned from base_row. The weapon's model replaces the vanilla Elden Ring model er_model (wp_a_<er_model>) with the AC6 model ac6_file converted on the player's PC (ac6_tex = its texture set); tip_len_m is the blade/barrel length from the grip at human scale (the frame is doubled in game); glow = colour of the energy parts.

rows.caption: A lightweight laser blade. Cuts fast, built for boosting in close.
A compact energy pistol. Takes Energy Cells.
rows.sfx_note: stock Elden Ring effects chosen by looking at them (effect parade): Moonveil streak = thin blue beam, Rennala comet = big blue orb, Gransax lightning spear = orange tracer. AC6's own FXR effects are not used.
rows.er_slot_note: held in the right hand: Elden Ring stows crossbows on the back (the shoulder pods hide it), so the rifle model goes into the dagger slot (row 1000000, wp_a_0100), which is always drawn in hand; R1 is disabled, the mod fires it

rows.note: Back weapon (R2 / L2). No Elden Ring weapon model: the DLL fires it. Bullet rows 999100x0 are built from AC6 data.
